metadata.title: quantum-group: Exact SymPy verification of explicit U_q(sl_2) and GL_q(2|1) matrix identities
metadata.description: Source archive of quantum-group 1.1.0, created with git archive from commit <full snapshot SHA> of https://github.com/TerekliTahaBerk/quantum-groups. A small SymPy package that builds the explicit matrices behind concrete quantum-group calculations and checks identities as exact residual matrices: finite-dimensional U_q(sl_2) representations, defining relations and generator-level Hopf identities, tensor products and Clebsch-Gordan highest-weight vectors, the fundamental R-matrix with Yang-Baxter, braid, Hecke and coproduct-intertwining checks, and the graded Yang-Baxter equation for the GL_q(2|1) R-matrix of Celik and Celik (2021). Checks are representation-level verifications, not proofs in the abstract algebra. This version has no GitHub Release; it is also distributed on PyPI as quantum-group 1.1.0. The earlier record 10.5281/zenodo.22997681 archives version 1.0.0 only.
